providerSetup.blocker: A ReadMe project administrator must generate a dedicated customer-owned API key and enter it in Relay Console.
providerSetup.nextAction: Generate a dedicated key under Configuration > API Keys, enter it in Relay Console, then run project health, a bounded search, and an approved or Dangerous-mode mutation.

evidence.supports: ReadMe API v2 uses customer-generated project API keys as Bearer credentials and recommends separate keys for separate integrations.
ReadMe identifies https://api.readme.com/v2 as the v2 API origin and documents GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE across the complete project-management surface.
The official API covers keys, references, API definitions, branches, categories, changelogs, custom pages, guides, images, recipes, and search.
ReadMe collections default to 10 results and support bounded page sizes up to 100; Relay convenience reads enforce documented limits.
ReadMe's official MCP server uses the same customer-owned rdme_ API key for authenticated read/write project management; it does not provide distributable Relay-owned OAuth.
